title: Leaf rectangles are preserved under input pull-back
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic communication protocol over input types $X$ and $Y$ producing values in $\alpha$, and let $f_X : X' \to X$ and $f_Y : Y' \to Y$ be arbitrary maps. Write $p'$ for the protocol over $X' \times Y'$ obtained from $p$ by pre-composing every message function with $f_X$ or $f_Y$ as appropriate. If $R \subseteq X \times Y$ is a leaf rectangle of $p$, then its pullback $\{(x', y') \in X' \times Y' \mid (f_X(x'), f_Y(y')) \in R\}$ along the product map $f_X \times f_Y$ is a leaf rectangle of $p'$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a protocol over X, Y with output type α
f_X : X' → X and f_Y : Y' → Y are maps
R is a leaf rectangle of p
replaced:
If $R$ is a leaf rectangle of $p$ and $f_X : X' \to X$, $f_Y : Y' \to Y$, then
$\texttt{preimageInputSet}(f_X, f_Y, R)$ is a leaf rectangle of $p.\texttt{comap}(f_X, f_Y)$.
